title: Council Chat Spec: One Stream, All Agents
summary: Chat is a running council. All agents in one chronological stream. User switches active agent by clicking or typing 'talk to [name]'. No separate per-agent chats. Two sides: Patrik (right) and agents (left).
content:
Council Chat Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-17

The Vision (Patrik, Mar 17)

"Chat is a running COUNCIL. All agents in the same stream. Everyone listens. Only the driving agent speaks. User switches by saying 'talk to Steffen' or clicking an agent. That agent steps forward in the SAME thread with full context. No separate chats. Council model."

"ONE conversation stream. ALL messages from Patrik (terminal, dashboard, telegram) + ALL messages from agents (relay responses) = one chronological list. No separation by source. No separation by device."

Layout

The chat lives in the sidebar (right panel, 30% width). It is a single continuous scroll.

Two Sides

Side Alignment Avatar Who
LEFT flex-start Agent circle (colored ring + initial) Any agent responding
RIGHT flex-end "P" circle (orange ring) Patrik (any source)

Active Agent Indicator

At the top of the chat, show which agent is currently "driving":

[Bobby avatar] Bobby is listening          [switch: search icon]

When Patrik types "talk to Steffen" or clicks a different agent, the indicator updates:

[Steffen avatar] Steffen is listening      [switch: search icon]

The switch icon opens the agent revolver (quick-switch to any agent).

Message Types

1. Agent Message (left side)

[B]  Garcia Construction homepage deployed.
     Brand refresh live. Permit tracker page next.

     VIA TERMINAL  10:08 AM
  • Circle avatar: agent's color ring, initial letter
  • Bubble: dark gray (#1E293B), rounded-2xl, flat bottom-left corner
  • Source pill: colored border pill (VIA TERMINAL = green, VIA DASHBOARD = blue)
  • Timestamp: small, gray, below bubble

2. Patrik Message (right side)

     Permit tracker looks good. Make sure the     [P]
     layout matches Steffen's brand guide.

                              VIA DASHBOARD  10:12 AM
  • Circle avatar: orange ring, "P" initial
  • Bubble: blue-tinted (#1E3A5F), rounded-2xl, flat bottom-right corner
  • Source pill: same as agent messages
  • Timestamp: right-aligned below bubble

3. Agent Switch Event (center)

When the active agent changes, show a centered event marker:

         ──── Steffen joined the conversation ────
                        10:20 AM
  • Centered, small text, muted color
  • Thin horizontal lines on each side
  • Not a bubble. Just a timeline marker.

4. System Event (center)

Commits, task completions, agent status changes:

     ● Bobby committed c9a1f27  10:09
  • Green dot for commits
  • Centered pill with monospace font
  • No avatar, no bubble

5. Agent Handoff (center, highlighted)

When one agent passes work to another:

    ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │  Bobby handed off to Steffen            │
    │  "Brand review on permit tracker page"  │
    └─────────────────────────────────────────┘
                    10:25 AM
  • Bordered card, centered
  • Agent colors on the border (Bobby blue left, Steffen green right)
  • Brief description of what was handed off

Agent Switching

Method 1: Type "talk to [agent]"

Patrik types "talk to Steffen" in the chat input. The system:

  1. Parses the command (regex: /^talk to (\w+)/i)
  2. Switches the active agent
  3. Inserts the "joined the conversation" event marker
  4. Routes subsequent messages to Steffen's relay
  5. Updates the sidebar header

This does NOT start a new conversation. The history stays. Steffen sees the full thread and picks up where Bobby left off.

Method 2: Click agent on the game map

Clicking a room/agent dot in the game viewport:

  1. Switches the active agent
  2. Inserts the "joined the conversation" event marker
  3. Sidebar header updates
  4. Camera zooms to that agent's room

Method 3: Agent Revolver

The search/switch icon in the sidebar header opens the agent list. Quick-select any agent. Same behavior as clicking on the map.

Data Model

All messages come from two files:

  • relay-inbox.jsonl (messages TO agents, from Patrik)
  • relay-outbox.jsonl (messages FROM agents, to Patrik)

The dashboard merges these into one chronological list sorted by timestamp.

interface Message {
  id: string;
  timestamp: string; // ISO 8601
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
  agent: string; // which agent context this was in
  content: string;
  source: 'terminal' | 'dashboard' | 'telegram';
}

Role Mapping Rules

Source File Role Side
relay-inbox.jsonl user RIGHT (Patrik)
relay-outbox.jsonl assistant LEFT (agent)

Agent Attribution

The agent field on outbox messages tells us which agent spoke. On inbox messages, the agent field tells us which agent Patrik was talking to. Both render the correct avatar.

When multiple agents respond in sequence (Bobby reports, then Steffen reviews), each message shows its own agent avatar on the left. The stream naturally shows the conversation flowing between agents.

Visual Specs

Sidebar Header

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  [Bobby circle]  Bobby                    🔍 │
│                  WEB DEV AGENT               │
│                  ● ACTIVE                    │
│                  19 builds  7 tasks          │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  CHAT c  TASKS t  INFO i  LIST 2  BOARD 3   │
│  ════                                        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  • Agent circle: 48px, colored ring (2px solid, agent color)
  • Name: 20px, weight 700
  • Role: 14px, uppercase, agent color, weight 600
  • Status pill: 12px, green bg for active
  • Stats: 16px, weight 600 numbers + 14px weight 400 labels
  • Tabs: 14px, uppercase, weight 600, keyboard shortcut hint

Chat Bubbles

  • Agent bubble bg: #1E293B (dark blue-gray)

  • Agent bubble border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.1)

  • Agent bubble shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)

  • Agent bubble radius: 16px 16px 16px 4px (flat bottom-left)

  • Patrik bubble bg: #1E3A5F (blue-tinted)

  • Patrik bubble border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15)

  • Patrik bubble shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)

  • Patrik bubble radius: 16px 16px 4px 16px (flat bottom-right)

  • Text: 15px, weight 400, #F1F5F9

  • Timestamp: 11px, weight 400, #64748B

  • Source pill: 11px, uppercase, weight 600, letter-spacing 0.05em

    • VIA TERMINAL: border #22C55E, text #22C55E
    • VIA DASHBOARD: border #3B82F6, text #3B82F6
    • VIA TELEGRAM: border #3B82F6, text #3B82F6
    • SYSTEM: border #64748B, text #64748B

Chat Input

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Talk to Bobby...                         ➤  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  • Pill shape: border-radius: 24px
  • Background: #1E293B
  • Border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15)
  • Focus: border rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4), shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1)
  • Placeholder: 15px, #64748B, shows current agent name
  • Send button: 36px circle, #3B82F6, white arrow icon
  • Padding: 12px 16px

Scroll Behavior

  • New messages auto-scroll to bottom
  • If user has scrolled up (reading history), DO NOT auto-scroll
  • Show "New messages" pill at bottom when auto-scroll is disabled
  • Custom thin scrollbar (4px, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2))

Typing Indicator

When an agent is processing (relay message sent, waiting for response):

[B]  ● ● ●

Three dots with bounce animation (150ms stagger). Agent avatar on left. Appears immediately when a message is sent, disappears when the response arrives.

Keyboard Shortcuts

Key Action
C Switch to CHAT tab
T Switch to TASKS tab
I Switch to INFO tab
/ Focus chat input
Esc Unfocus chat input
Cmd+K Open agent revolver (quick switch)

What This Replaces

  • Per-agent separate chat panels: DEAD
  • ChatDashboard.jsx with separate agent routing: refactor to single stream
  • Multiple chat windows/tabs: ONE stream
  • Agent-specific chat histories: merged into council thread

Files for Bobby

File Purpose
components/CouncilChat.tsx Single stream chat component
components/AgentSwitchEvent.tsx "Steffen joined" event markers
components/SystemEvent.tsx Commit/status event markers
hooks/useCouncilStream.ts Merge inbox+outbox, sort by timestamp
Update GameDashboard.jsx Replace per-agent chat with CouncilChat
